study: Yearly number of M>=5 earthquakes worldwide and stability of the Gutenberg-Richter b-value, 1976-2025
unit_of_observation: one catalogue event (raw/clean tables); one calendar year (annual table); one decade and Mc rule (b-value table)
population_note: The ANSS ComCat catalogue records what global networks detected and located, not every earthquake. Completeness depends on magnitude and period; the study describes the catalogue, with the completeness magnitude Mc estimated per decade from events down to M4.5.

tables.name: usgs_raw_1976_1985
tables.series: earthquakes of magnitude 4.5 and above worldwide, 1976-01-01 to 1986-01-01
tables.role: raw event table, part 1 of 5 (loaded per decade so each request stays under the service's 40-window split limit)
tables.load: e2er-data usgs events --start 1976-01-01 --end 1986-01-01 --min-magnitude 4.5 --table usgs_raw_1976_1985 --save-to usgs_raw_1976_1985.csv  (no --event-type, so explosions, quarry blasts and other types are kept for the quality check)

tables.name: eq_clean_m45
tables.role: cleaned table for Mc estimation, annual counts and b-values; built by the data analyst's cleaning script with the rules in `cleaning`; raw tables are never overwritten

columns.name: mag_class
columns.description: moment-magnitude family (mw, mww, mwc, mwb, mwr, mwp) vs body-wave (mb, mb_lg) vs surface-wave (ms) vs local/duration (ml, md) vs other

tables.name: eq_annual_counts
tables.role: one row per calendar year 1976-2025: counts of M>=5 (primary), M>=5.5, M>=6, M>=7 and M>=4.5; M>=5 counts by magnitude class and by depth (<=70 km); the largest magnitude. Counting only, no tests. Counts at the common threshold (largest decade Mc) are computed in the analysis step, once the decade Mc values exist.

columns.name: n_m50_mw
columns.description: M>=5 events whose magType is in the moment-magnitude family

columns.name: n_m50_other
columns.description: M>=5 events with any other magType

tables.name: eq_bvalue_windows
tables.series: decade windows for the b-value analysis (sample sizes only)
tables.role: sample sizes per decade (1976-85, 1986-95, 1996-2005, 2006-15, 2016-25; no sliding windows). Mc (maximum curvature +0.2, goodness-of-fit 90/95%, common threshold = largest decade Mc), n above Mc and the b-value (Aki-Utsu MLE, dM = 0.1) are estimates and are computed in the analysis step from eq_clean_m45, not stored here.

columns.name: n_total
columns.description: events in the decade with mag >= 4.5

cleaning.event_type: keep type == 'earthquake' only. Count and report removed rows by type (explosion, nuclear explosion, quarry blast, mining explosion, other) and by decade. Fixed-period reload with --event-type earthquake is not used for the raw tables so that these counts exist.
cleaning.time_range: origin time 1976-01-01T00:00:00Z to 2025-12-31T23:59:59Z; year = UTC year.
cleaning.magnitude_filter: drop mag < 4.5 (already excluded by the request) and rows with null mag. The request filters on magnitude, so null-magnitude events cannot appear in the raw tables; their number is not observable here and the paper says so.
cleaning.magnitude_type_handling: No conversion between magnitude types in the primary analysis: the preferred magnitude 'mag' of ComCat is used as published (one preferred magnitude per event), and magType is kept and lower-cased. mww/mw/mwc/mwb/mwr are treated as one moment-magnitude family; mb and ms are kept separate; ml/md are rare at M>=4.5. Checks: (a) the mix of magType per decade is reported; (b) counts and b-values restricted to the moment-magnitude family; (c) a shallow sample (depth <= 70 km). ComCat's preferred magnitude mixes types over time, so a shift in the mix is a possible catalogue artefact and is reported, not corrected.
cleaning.duplicates: key = id. Drop repeated ids across the five raw tables (boundary events are loaded once only because windows are half-open, but check). Also flag near-duplicates: events within 16 s, 100 km and 0.5 magnitude units of each other, reported by net pair; flagged ones are listed, and removed only in a documented sensitivity run. No silent dropping.
cleaning.depth: depth in km; negative values (above sea level) are kept and counted; no depth filter in the primary tables (the shallow check uses depth <= 70 km).

expected_quality_checks: rows per raw table, rows per year, and the decade each row falls in; 50 calendar years all present in eq_annual_counts
share of rows by type; count of explosions, quarry blasts and nuclear explosions removed
null counts for time, latitude, longitude, depth, mag, magType, net
share of rows by magType and by net per decade (shows the mix shift)
range checks: latitude in [-90, 90], longitude in [-180, 180], depth in [-5, 800] km, mag in [4.5, 10]
status split reviewed vs automatic per year (recent months are mostly automatic; 2025 events may still be revised)
event counts per request against the service limit; the load stops rather than saving a cut table
missing_values_note: Columns nst, gap, dmin, rms, horizontalError, depthError, magError and magNst are mostly empty before 2000 and are not used; they are not declared and are not checked.

unavailable.reason: no available source holds it (not among usgs, exoplanets, gaia, nasa_power, worldbank, eurostat, owid, who_gho, gutenberg, github, gisco, naturalearth, and no data files supplied). The cross-check is dropped; instead ComCat events with magType in the Mw family serve as the internal check, and the paper names the limitation.

known_limits: ComCat is compiled from several networks; its preferred magnitude type changes over time, and completeness in the 1970s-80s may be above 4.5 worldwide, so M>=4.5 counts are not assumed comparable across decades. The primary count series uses M>=5, and counts are also given at one common threshold equal to the largest decade Mc.
ComCat events are revised after review; the load records its date and a later load can differ slightly (especially for 2025).
Aftershocks are included and not removed.
citation: U.S. Geological Survey (2017). Advanced National Seismic System (ANSS) Comprehensive Catalog. https://doi.org/10.5066/F7MS3QZH (BibTeX key USGS_ComCat)
